title: Operating System
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a programming-language construct, so the compiler knows they are special and can handle calls to monitor procedures differently from other procedure calls."
Monitors are a programming-language construct, so the compiler knows they are special and can handle calls to monitor procedures differently from other procedure calls.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a passive entity that does not perform any actions by itself; it has to be executed if the actions it calls for are to take place."
A program is a passive entity that does not perform any actions by itself; it has to be executed if the actions it calls for are to take place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the wasted (unused) space within a page."
Internal fragmentation is the wasted (unused) space within a page.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bit controversial, and a hybrid implementation is also possible."
The choice is a bit controversial, and a hybrid implementation is also possible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
Tutor-Marked Assignment (TMAs) The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unit of work in a modern time-sharing system."
A process is the unit of work in a modern time-sharing system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the system by which the memory of a computer system is divided into sections for use by the resident programs."
Memory Partitioning Memory partitioning is the system by which the memory of a computer system is divided into sections for use by the resident programs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to indicate whether any process is currently using the critical section."
The boolean variable busy is used to indicate whether any process is currently using the critical section.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of an operating system that supports a single user process and a single thread."
MS- DOS is an example of an operating system that supports a single user process and a single thread.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of procedures, variables, and data structures that are all grouped together in a special kind of module or package."
Monitors A monitor is a collection of procedures, variables, and data structures that are all grouped together in a special kind of module or package.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the offset value die in (i) 0430 the 1st digit 0 refer to segment and 430 refers to offset value for the logical address (0430)."
S while remaining digits refers to the offset value die in (i) 0430 the 1st digit 0 refer to segment and 430 refers to offset value for the logical address (0430).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of shifting a user program from one memory location to another."
Relocation is a method of shifting a user program from one memory location to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a piece of software that monitors and recovers from computer problems."
A watchdog timer is a piece of software that monitors and recovers from computer problems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of all logical addresses generated by CPU for a program whereas the set of all physical address mapped to corresponding logical addresses is called Physical Address Space."

Logical Address Space is the set of all logical addresses generated by CPU for a program whereas the set of all physical address mapped to corresponding logical addresses is called Physical Address Space.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the key elements of process synchronization, so a solution to a process synchronization problem should incorporate a suitable combination of these elements."
Critical sections and signaling are the key elements of process synchronization, so a solution to a process synchronization problem should incorporate a suitable combination of these elements.
fib: ______ is the poor performance of a virtual memory (or paging) system when the same pages are being loaded repeatedly due to a lack of main memory to keep them in memory.
Thrashing Thrash
Thrashing Thrash is the poor performance of a virtual memory (or paging) system when the same pages are being loaded repeatedly due to a lack of main memory to keep them in memory.
______ is used to break out of the while loop after the producer produces into an empty buffer.
boolean variable produced
The boolean variable produced is used to break out of the while loop after the producer produces into an empty buffer.
______ is used to handle blocking and activation of readers and writers.
signaling arrangement
A signaling arrangement is used to handle blocking and activation of readers and writers.
______ is a piece of software that controls the hardware on a computer.
operating system
An operating system is a piece of software that controls the hardware on a computer.
______ is an illusion of parallelism, activities that appear to be parallel, but may not be actually so.
Concurrency
Concurrency is an illusion of parallelism, activities that appear to be parallel, but may not be actually so.
______ is a computing model in which multiple processors execute instructions simultaneously for better performance.
Concurrent processing
Concurrent processing is a computing model in which multiple processors execute instructions simultaneously for better performance.
______ is the inability to use memory because free memory is divided into many small blocks.
External fragmentation
External fragmentation is the inability to use memory because free memory is divided into many small blocks.
______ is a non-maskable interrupt, that cannot be ignored or disabled by the processor 3).
NMI
NMI is a non-maskable interrupt, that cannot be ignored or disabled by the processor 3).
______ is a Boolean function of the allocation state.
validity constraint
The validity constraint is a Boolean function of the allocation state.
______ is the system of dividing memory into non-overlapping but variable sizes.
Variable partitioning
Variable partitioning Variable partitioning is the system of dividing memory into non-overlapping but variable sizes.
______ is considered better if it avoids internal fragmentation.
partition allocation method
A partition allocation method is considered better if it avoids internal fragmentation.
______ is an example of non-preemptive scheduling. 2.
FIFO
FIFO is an example of non-preemptive scheduling. 2.
______ is the state of permanent blocking of a set of processes each waiting for event to occur.
Deadlock
Deadlock is the state of permanent blocking of a set of processes each waiting for event to occur.
______ is an example of a system of one process with multiple threads.
Java run-time environment
A Java run-time environment is an example of a system of one process with multiple threads.
